// TypeScript module

type EventHandler<Args extends unknown[]> = (...args: Args) => void
type WildcardHandler = (eventName: string, ...args: unknown[]) => void

class EventEmitter<Events extends Record<string, unknown[]>> {
  private listeners: Map<keyof Events | '*', Set<Function>>
  private onceWrappers: WeakMap<Function, Function>  // maps original -> wrapper for cleanup

  constructor():
    listeners = new Map()
    onceWrappers = new WeakMap()

  on<K extends keyof Events>(event: K, handler: EventHandler<Events[K]>): this
    getOrCreate set for event, add handler, return this

  on(event: '*', handler: WildcardHandler): this
    same but for wildcard set

  once<K extends keyof Events>(event: K, handler: EventHandler<Events[K]>): this
    wrapper = (...args) => { this.off(event, handler); handler(...args) }
    onceWrappers.set(handler, wrapper)
    return this.on(event, wrapper as any)

  off<K extends keyof Events>(event: K, handler?: EventHandler<Events[K]>): this
    if no handler: delete entire set for event
    else: remove handler (check onceWrappers too), return this

  emit<K extends keyof Events>(event: K, ...args: Events[K]): this
    call all handlers for event with args
    call all '*' handlers with (event as string, ...args)
    return this

  listenerCount<K extends keyof Events>(event: K): number
    return set size or 0
}

export function createEmitter<Events extends Record<string, unknown[]>>(): EventEmitter<Events>
  return new EventEmitter<Events>()
